items.current_behavior: Normalizes requested extraction method to auto, docling, pymupdf, or anthropic and maps the selected method to run_multipass_extraction parser_backend/strict_parser settings.
items.proposed_deterministic_extension: Do not route on ASX type here first. Later, this can attach an already-computed read-only ASX document-type artifact to method provenance without changing parser_backend.
hard_stops: no parser_backend changes
no strict_parser relaxation
no canonical writes
no prompt changes

items.current_behavior: Builds Docling/PyMuPDF StructuredDocument objects with pages, tables, sections, method, parser id, and parser warnings. Strict Docling does not fallback to PyMuPDF.
items.proposed_deterministic_extension: ASX classifier consumes filename/title, first-page text, table captions, headers, and row anchors from StructuredDocument as a sidecar input.
hard_stops: do not promote PyMuPDF as truth
do not change Docling cache behavior
do not run OCR in this audit
do not drop rows or tables

items.current_behavior: LLM classifier infers report_type A/H/Q, period_end, currency, scale, and confidence from first-page text. It does not model Appendix 4C/4D/4E/5B document type.
items.proposed_deterministic_extension: Keep Pass 1 unchanged. Add a separate deterministic ASXDocumentType artifact that can be compared against report_type without controlling production flow.
hard_stops: do not replace LLM report_type gate in production
do not weaken low-confidence failure behavior
do not treat document_type as metric truth

items.current_behavior: Deterministically scores Docling tables for income_statement, cashflow, balance_sheet, share_capital_note, highlights, and net_debt_note. Existing logic includes Appendix 4D/4E unit scanning and Appendix 5B disqualification for non-cashflow table slots.
items.proposed_deterministic_extension: Add statement-table selector comparators that rank current-period formal statement tables by ASX type while emitting only sidecar artifacts until fixtures prove no regression.
hard_stops: do not change selected table winners before no-regression gates
do not infer missing statement metrics from Appendix 5B
do not override currency/scale abstain behavior

items.current_behavior: Appendix 5B is recognized through cashflow table captions/rows, merged cashflow candidates, disqualification from income/balance slots, and quarterly validation that accepts limited cashflow metrics.
items.proposed_deterministic_extension: Design a separate Appendix 5B line-item parser artifact over Docling rows, including line numbers, labels, current-quarter/YTD columns, currency, scale, and arithmetic checks.
hard_stops: no canonical truth writes
no generic receipts-as-revenue mapping
no scoring without Appendix 5B gate stack

items.current_behavior: Evaluates strict real-gold fixtures with trusted/abstain/quarantine semantics. Context mismatch quarantines; missing required metric abstains.
items.proposed_deterministic_extension: Add comparator artifact references only after fixture provenance is explicit. Keep canonical trust labels unchanged.
hard_stops: do not change gold labels
do not broaden real-gold supported metrics in this lane
do not mutate expected_trust

items.current_behavior: Builds read-only confirmed metric coverage inventory from backend/tests/eval_fixtures and separates canonical_core, expanded_required, and confirmed_metric_coverage profiles.
items.proposed_deterministic_extension: Use it as the measurement surface for expanded fixture expectations after deterministic parser artifacts exist, not as production truth.
hard_stops: no production extraction coverage claim from fixture inventory alone
no canonical label mutation
no extractor output treated as gold

items.current_behavior: Persists successful extraction runs and upserts ASXPeriodicFinancial rows for supported metric fields in a single DB transaction.
items.proposed_deterministic_extension: No first-phase extension. Parser artifacts must stay report-local or comparator-only until all gates pass.
hard_stops: no DB writes
no ASXPeriodicFinancial schema or field writes
no canonical write path changes

items.owner_function: classify_document, normalize_document_classifier_result call site in extract_financial_metrics main
items.current_behavior: Script-level first-page classifier distinguishes broad financial_report, appendix_report, announcement, presentation, investor_update, and unknown types; strict script mode can skip non-financial Docling extraction.
items.proposed_deterministic_extension: Use only as prior art for a pure ASX classifier test contract. Do not bind production backend extraction to this script surface.
hard_stops: do not run script extraction jobs
do not import script classifier into backend routing without a separate design
do not use broad appendix_report as ASX type truth

items.current_behavior: Camelot is a script-only cashflow fallback for scoped cashflow pages and CAPEX numeric recovery. Backend dependency guard requires Docling and forbids Camelot in backend requirements.
items.proposed_deterministic_extension: Treat Camelot only as a comparator/fallback artifact source in isolated script/report lanes.
hard_stops: do not add Camelot to backend requirements
do not make Camelot production truth
do not use fallback outside cashflow-scoped evidence
